body:
Package: I ordered 40mg/ml 10ml vial from pawsnax on 11/06/2026. I received it on 11/16/2026. The packaging is discreet; a plain black plastic envelope, and securely double bubble wrapped. The vial is itself is cute, the labeling is both discrete and clear. The vial looks good, the liquid looks good. I used it for my first shot yesterday, (yeah first shot ever, so I don't know what estrogen oil is supposed to look like specifically, but I know what inevitables look like, and this is very professional), and it’s definitely estrogen.

Tracking: The tracking system is really cool and functional. The tracking did update a little slow, but I used to sell recreational drugs, and I didn't want live tracking of the package- it might have helped my anxiety a little to watch it move on a normal tracker, but I think this way is much safer and I appreciate that someone gave me that option. 

Ordering/UI: I am middle aged and hate computers and the internet and crypto and the how-to guide on their website was really clear and easy to follow step by step. I cannot praise these women enough.
